issues.description: The UML in the problem statement specifies addGuestStudents(int) with a void return type, but the solution implements addGuestStudents(int) returning boolean. The template indicates students should follow the UML. This mismatch can confuse students about the expected signature and return value (and may cause tests or grading code to fail if they expect void).
issues.suggestedFix: Make the return type consistent across artifacts. Either (A) change the solution's addGuestStudents method to return void (remove boolean return values) to match the UML/problem statement and update its implementation to just add the guests, or (B) update the problem statement UML and template guidance to indicate the method returns boolean and document when/why it returns false. Prefer option A if the UML is authoritative for the exercise.
